name: Beneath the Bleeding Moon
source:
Adashima Haru was born in the lap of luxury. He lives with his mother in the heart of Kyoto, in a spacious home with servants to tend to his every need. Haru has everything a young man could ever want…

At a glance, at least.

In actuality, however, Haru’s life isn’t so perfect.

Haru’s mother is stern and controlling, and she dictates every facet of Haru’s life. She is adamant that Haru should dress like a woman, and she constantly berates him for not behaving like a young lady.

Haru's life is dull and uninteresting... until he runs into a thief, Kishou, during a rare shopping excursion.

After discovering that Haru is a young man, not a young woman, Kishou breaks into Haru’s home in the dead of night in an attempt to blackmail him – and, in so doing, Kishou’s destiny becomes irrevocably entwined with Haru’s.

On that fateful night, Haru and Kishou are set a task: to travel the country slaying monsters, so that they might break a centuries-old curse that has plagued Haru’s family for generations.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2553080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
阿达岛春出生在奢华的环境中。他和母亲住在京都市中心一栋宽敞的房子里，还有仆人来满足他的一切需要。Haru拥有年轻人想要的一切……

至少乍一看是这样。

但事实上，Haru的生活并不那么完美。

哈鲁的母亲严厉且控制欲强，她支配着哈鲁生活的方方面面。她坚持认为哈鲁应该穿得像个女人，并且不断地斥责他表现得不像个年轻女士。

哈鲁的生活平淡无奇……直到他在一次罕见的购物之旅中遇到小偷纪翔。

在发现Haru是一名年轻男子而不是年轻女子后，Kishou在夜深人静时闯入Haru的家，试图敲诈他 - 如此一来，Kishou的命运就与Haru的命运不可挽回地交织在一起。

在那个命运攸关的夜晚，Haru和Kishou接到了一项任务：前往全国各地杀死怪物，这样他们就可以打破困扰Haru家族几代人的数百年诅咒。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2553080/]Steam[/url]]
